walkthroughs.body_html:
Theme 4: Global Business — a core area of A-Level Business Studies.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Theme 4: Global Business brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Theme 4: Global Business.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: Porter's three generic strategies are cost leadership, differentiation and:
options: Diversification
Focus
Innovation
Acquisition

mcqs.q: The 'Blue Ocean' concept was proposed by:
options: Porter
Kim and Mauborgne
Hamel and Prahalad
Drucker
Economies of scale means total costs decrease as the business grows.
Economies of scale means a business saves the economy money.
The 7Ps include Profit, Planning and Performance.
Cost advantages a firm gains as it grows — average cost per unit falls because fixed costs spread over more units, bulk discounts, and specialisation become possible.
Productivity is the total amount produced by a business.
Productivity is the number of employees a business has.
Output per unit of input (per worker, per hour) — measuring efficiency, not total output. A small efficient firm can be more productive than a large inefficient one.
The 7Ps include Profit, Planning and Performance.

mcqs.q: What three Ps are added to make the extended marketing mix (7Ps)?
options: The 7Ps are just the 4Ps repeated with different words.
The 7Ps include Profit, Planning and Performance.
Productivity is the number of employees a business has.
People (staff/service quality), Process (how the service is delivered), and Physical Evidence (tangible cues — uniforms, packaging, branding) — added to make the 4Ps relevant to services marketing.
